title: Existing codebase
description: Loaded when detection finds an existing codebase. The theme throughout: inherit debt as an explicit baseline rather than pretending the repository was always this way.

questions.ask: Which parts of the existing code are off limits?
questions.rationale: Becomes a hard boundary on every write lease. Legacy that nobody understands belongs here.

questions.ask: How should existing violations be treated?
questions.rationale: Ratcheting scopes every check to the diff, so adopting the framework does not turn the whole repository red on day one.
